seo-intelligence.purpose: Perplexity Search API + SERP + GSC + HubSpot + Places (24 tools). RUNG 1 of the research skill's tool ladder — ~$0.005/query flat, never the $5-40 chat models
seo-intelligence.whenToLoad: research/search tasks FIRST (prefer over web_search); also GSC, SERP, Places and HubSpot tasks. NOTE: requires a one-time `npm install` in mcp-servers/seo-intelligence per checkout, or the entry fails to spawn

tortoise._comment: HOSTED Tortoise MCP over HTTP. This replaced the legacy stdio entry (${TORTOISE_HOME}/.venv/bin/python3 -m tortoise.mcp_server + a local TORTOISE_DB_URI=docker://...:16379) that needed a tortoise checkout, a venv AND a local FalkorDB — none of which exists on a cmux cloud cell, which is why pi-bootstrap/cell-install.sh refused to install this file on cells at all and every fleet lane on a cell ran with ZERO MCP servers, writing GRAPH-UNREACHABLE into its report. The DB target is resolved SERVER-SIDE (FALKORDB_CLOUD_URI), so a client needs only the endpoint and the key. Auth is env-indirect: ${TORTOISE_MCP_API_KEY} is the STANDARD name (skills/research/SKILL.md; #5153/#5343) and TORTOISE_API_KEY is the legacy alias, which the fallback script still reads (MCP first, then the alias) but this entry does NOT — point the header at ONE name, because a plain ${VAR} expands to the EMPTY STRING when unset and the server then answers 401 instead of failing loudly. lazy=true is deliberate: the hosted server's cold handshake routinely exceeds pi's default MCP connect budget, and this entry now lands on memory-constrained cells where a core server would block every session start. Self-host users point url at their own daemon instead (http://localhost:8000/mcp — docs/quickstart-selfhosted.md).
tortoise.purpose: Memory graph (Tortoise, hosted) — read before you derive, write what you learn
tortoise.whenToLoad: any lane: graph read before research, write-back after (`mcp_load tortoise`)
tortoise.cost: one HTTP session; lazy, so nothing is paid while it sleeps

orchestrator.purpose: Fleet/orchestrator surface — 11 tools / 12 MCP names (agent-infra#3382): lane.list, lane.show, lane.artifact, fleet.census, pr.queue, claim.check, lane.dispatch, box.exec, pr.review_record, pr.closure_audit, fleet.reminder, fleet.beat_checkpoint. EIGHT are reads; lane.dispatch, box.exec, fleet.reminder and fleet.beat_checkpoint MUTATE, so this entry is NOT read-only — launch it with --read-only (or ORCH_MCP_READ_ONLY=1) to refuse every mutating tool. box.exec is destructiveHint/openWorldHint and runs allowlisted ARGV commands on cells.
orchestrator.whenToLoad: whenever the question is 'did this lane finish?' / 'which lanes are running?' / 'what expired?' — i.e. any beat's lane census — plus PR review state (pr.review_record), closure audits and claim checks. NOT a substitute for tools/fleet/liveness.py (the one liveness verdict): the registry answers about the RECORD, liveness answers about the process.
orchestrator.cost: zero while sleeping (lazy); 1 python process per call plus the wrapped CLI's own cost (1 git fetch for lane reads, 1+ gh call for pr/claim reads, 1 cmux exec for box.exec)
